resources.string: Branch saved. You can continue chatting independently.
Branch saved from visible history. Original tool history could not be aligned.
Could not create the branch. Finish running or editing, then retry. Check saving if a draft branch appears.

Branches copy saved history through a chosen message and continue independently. New branches inherit model, character, project, folder and context settings. Later edits remain independent. Creating or opening a branch never runs tools.
Could not load branch data. Retry.
The stored graph has missing or circular relations. All nodes remain visible.
No branches yet. Use the branch action on a saved user message or final reply.
Reconstructed from visible messages; original tool details may be unavailable.
Delete this chat and its messages? Descendant chats remain. Their original source may become unavailable.
Running or editing; deletion is temporarily unavailable.
The source message is no longer available. The copied branch history remains.
Export did not finish. Retry with a writable location.
Saving the branch. This final commit cannot be cancelled.
Export cancelled. The selected document may contain partial data.
Branch settings need attention. Open Conversation branches to retry or use current settings.
The saved settings are waiting to be linked.
Could not apply branch settings. Retry before running a task.
Folder or context settings could not be linked. Check whether the folder still exists.
The original project could not be linked. Check whether it still exists and is active.
Keep settings already applied and any changes you made. Stop applying the remaining original project, folder and context settings. The branch history stays intact.
No matching branches. Matching chats keep their ancestors visible.
This branch would copy too much history (more than 32,000 messages or 16 Mi character units). Choose an earlier message and try again.
More replies or tools follow this message in the same turn. Select the final reply in that turn.
The source message has changed or is no longer available. Refresh the conversation and select a branch point again.
The saved tool batch is incomplete. A branch cannot be created from this history yet.
